mostWorthwhile.text: Wrapping the air sacs in capillaries was most worthwhile: it showed why air and blood need a thin, close exchange surface.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding elastic support was less informative: the picture showed the fibres but did not explain how they help breathing.

surprise.text: The surfactant explanation clarified how the tiny sacs resist collapsing as they get smaller during breathing.

arbitrary.text: None felt arbitrary, although several later choices were the only offered combinations and added little explanation.

continue.text: I would be somewhat interested in another chapter to see how the connected systems support the body, though I would hope for more explanation of intermediate constructions.
